why: The curator asked for these two links on the dashboard. Batch 178 put them in the article section instead, which was the wrong place: the dashboard has its own curated-link model, DashboardLink, feeding the ticker, the newswire and the event map. This batch puts them where they were meant to go and removes the article.

links.title: Federal Judge Rejects Hood County Sheriff's Qualified Immunity Bid In Meme Arrest Lawsuit
Citizen Arrested for a Meme Sues Hood County Officials

remove_article.why: Written by batch 178 in the wrong place. The text is not lost — it is still in database/data/fixes/batch178.json in the repository if it is ever wanted as a piece. Deleted only if it is there, so this is safe whether or not batch 178 has been run on this server yet.

notes.category: Both are filed as prosecution rather than arrest. The arrest itself was in November 2025; these two report its legal aftermath — the civil suit and the qualified-immunity ruling.
notes.coordinates: Both are plotted on Granbury, the Hood County seat, where the sheriff's office, the jail and the justice court all sit.
notes.titles: Each title is the headline as the outlet prints it. The Dallas Express headline is not the one in the URL slug, which reads denied-qualified-immunity; the page itself says Federal Judge Rejects Hood County Sheriffs Qualified Immunity Bid.
notes.idempotency: updateOrCreate keyed on the URL, matching dashboard:add-keith-rose-cleared, so a re-run refreshes rather than duplicates.
